title: Gratitude Fuels Grind | A Discipline Short Film
lines: He had grown cold from the grind.
So he wrote down three things he was thankful for.
The health to wake up. The chance to try. The people who stayed.
Gratitude doesn't slow ambition. It steadies it.
You can want more and still be thankful.
Work from a full heart, not an empty one.
That's the kind of drive that lasts.
